title: Interpreting Timestamp Permutations in Dynamic Link Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2611.23753v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Timestamp permutations are used to test whether dynamic link predictors exploit temporal information, but a performance gap can reflect changes in training, evaluation history, or both. We separate these effects with a crossed diagnostic and measure input exposure: whether altered histories actually change the predictor's inputs. On MOOC, TCL trained with binary cross-entropy gains approximately eight pairwise-accuracy points from original-chronology training under either evaluation history, while changing history at fixed weights gives only 0.03 points. The small history contrast reflects unchanged inputs for 68.37% of queries, stable rankings for most others, and cancellation of gains and losses. Under original evaluation history, suppressing explicit time encoding reduces the training contrast from 8.03 to 3.64 points, a paired reduction of 4.39 points (95% interval [3.68, 5.09]) across six seeds. translated_title: 动态链接预测中时间戳置换的解读
translated_abstract: 时间戳置换常被用来测试动态链接预测器是否利用了时间信息，但由此产生的性能差距可能反映的是训练的变化、评估历史的变化，或两者兼有。我们通过一种交叉诊断方法将这些效应分离开来，并测量输入暴露度：即被改变的历史是否真的改变了预测器的输入。在MOOC数据集上，使用二元交叉熵训练的TCL模型，在任一评估历史下都能从原始时序训练中获得约八个成对准确率百分点的提升，而在固定权重下改变评估历史仅带来0.03个百分点的变化。这种微小的历史对比源于68.37%的查询输入保持不变、其余大多数查询的排名稳定，以及增益与损失的相互抵消。在原始评估历史下，抑制显式时间编码会使训练对比从8.03个百分点降至3.64个百分点，即在六个随机种子上的配对减少量为4.39个百分点（95%置信区间为[3.68, 5.09]）。DyGFormer也显示出相应的训练……（摘要内容在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种交叉诊断方法，将时间戳置换实验中的训练效应与评估历史效应分离，并发现动态链接预测器的性能差距主要源于原始时序训练（尤其是显式时间编码）的贡献，而非评估历史的改变。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a crossed diagnostic to disentangle training effects from evaluation-history effects in timestamp permutation tests, showing that performance gaps in dynamic link prediction primarily stem from original-chronology training—largely driven by explicit time encoding—rather than altered evaluation histories.
